answer.says: Ramesh, the gate is open. Shri Hegde, I trust you will find the second bedroom to your liking, though I suspect you would prefer the first.
answer.thought: The hazy air settles on the skin, a fine grey veil that blurs the sharpness of the morning. I step over the threshold, leaving the domestic sphere behind to confront the objective world. The walk is not merely exercise; it is the movement of the spirit into space, testing the ground beneath my feet against the abstract map in my head. I must see the tombs before the heat makes them mere shapes in the haze.
